g.text: Title: LoRa multifunction vehicle node V2 - MCU

g.desc: Title: LoRa multifunction vehicle node V2 - MCU

g.style: fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: Power, link, fix and fault labels describe intended application states. Firmware must define and verify the indications.

g.desc: Power, link, fix and fault labels describe intended application states. Firmware must define and verify the indications.

g.text: Functional groups / electrical pin numbers / named-net connections

g.desc: Functional groups / electrical pin numbers / named-net connections

g.text: Read named nets within each group; matching labels are electrically connected. Cross-sheet signals use hierarchical ports.

g.desc: Read named nets within each group; matching labels are electrically connected. Cross-sheet signals use hierarchical ports.

g.text: VDDA filter is fed from +3V3. BOOT0 pull-down selects flash boot; NRST is available at the debug header.

g.desc: VDDA filter is fed from +3V3. BOOT0 pull-down selects flash boot; NRST is available at the debug header.

g.text: 3.3 V logic. Labels define the current board wiring; fleet/ground-vehicle and handheld behavior still requires firmware and interface qualification.

g.desc: 3.3 V logic. Labels define the current board wiring; fleet/ground-vehicle and handheld behavior still requires firmware and interface qualification.

g.text: HSE: 8 MHz / CL 10 pF. LSE: 32.768 kHz / CL 7 pF. Check actual stray capacitance and startup; LSE is a population option.

g.desc: HSE: 8 MHz / CL 10 pF. LSE: 32.768 kHz / CL 7 pF. Check actual stray capacitance and startup; LSE is a population option.

g.text: V1 preserves original defects. V2 is a review draft. Bench values and firmware behavior require validation.

g.desc: V1 preserves original defects. V2 is a review draft. Bench values and firmware behavior require validation.

g.text: Place each 100 nF capacitor near its VDD pin. C20 is the 4.7 uF VCAP_1-to-GND capacitor. VBAT is tied to VDD.

g.desc: Place each 100 nF capacitor near its VDD pin. C20 is the 4.7 uF VCAP_1-to-GND capacitor. VBAT is tied to VDD.
